description-en: The canonical desktop productivity layout: a fixed-width sidebar (220-280px) with navigation or list, and a flex-1 detail area on the right. On macOS, account for the traffic-light buttons (safe area ~72px from top-left). Sidebar items: 36-40px row height, icon + label, active state with a 3px left accent bar.
description-zh: 桌面生产力经典布局：固定宽侧栏 220-280px 放置导航或列表，右侧 flex-1 为详情区。macOS 需为红绿灯按钮留出顶部左侧约 72px 安全区。侧栏项行高 36-40px，图标 + 文本，激活态以 3px 左侧主色条标识。

name-zh: 数据表格 — 斑马纹可排序
description-en: A dense data table for desktop. Header row: uppercase 0.7rem, tracking 0.1em, sticky. Body rows: 36-40px height, alternating background every 2 rows (not every row — too busy). Sortable columns get a subtle ▲▼ indicator. Numeric columns right-aligned, text columns left-aligned. Row hover: sky-50 tint.
description-zh: 桌面密集数据表。表头行大写 0.7rem 字距 0.1em 粘性定位。体行高 36-40px，每两行交替底色（非逐行交替——太花）。可排序列带细微 ▲▼ 指示器。数字列右对齐，文本列左对齐。行悬停：sky-50 浅蓝底色。
css: table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%}thead th{position:sticky;top:0;background:#fff;font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:2px solid rgba(20,58,92,.18)}tbody td{padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(20,58,92,.1)}tbody tr:nth-child(4n+1),tbody tr:nth-child(4n+2){background:#F4F8FC}

name-en: Window Title Bar — macOS Traffic Lights
name-zh: 窗口标题栏 — macOS 红绿灯
description-en: When building Electron or native macOS windows, the top-left corner is occupied by the traffic-light buttons (close/minimize/fullscreen). Reserve a 72px × 22px safe zone. Title text should be centered in the title bar, not left-aligned. Draggable region: the entire title bar area. Use -webkit-app-region: drag on the bar and no-drag on interactive elements.
description-zh: Electron 或原生 macOS 窗口中，左上角被红绿灯按钮占据。预留 72px×22px 安全区。标题文字居中而非靠左。整个标题栏为可拖拽区域。用 -webkit-app-region: drag 在栏上，交互元素用 no-drag。

description-en: A floating menu triggered by right-click or long-press. Items: icon + label, 32px row height, divider lines between groups. Keyboard shortcut hints right-aligned in mono. Max 8 items before scrolling. Never put a sub-menu deeper than 1 level — it's a usability cliff.
description-zh: 右键或长按触发的浮动菜单。项：图标 + 文本，行高 32px，组间用分隔线。快捷键提示右对齐用等宽字体。超过 8 项时可滚动。子菜单深度禁止超过 1 层——可用性断崖。

name-zh: 设置面板 — 分类表单
description-en: Settings organized into categories with a left nav (180-220px) and right form area. Each setting row: label left, control right, 44px min height. Use toggles for boolean settings, selects for 3-6 options, radio groups for 2-3 mutually exclusive. Group related settings under a section header with a hairline divider.
description-zh: 设置按分类组织：左侧导航 180-220px，右侧表单区。每行设置：标签左、控件右，最小行高 44px。布尔值用开关，3-6 选项用下拉，2-3 互斥项用单选组。相关设置归组，用节标题+发丝线分隔。

description-en: Triggered by pressing '?' or Cmd+/. A modal overlay listing all keyboard shortcuts grouped by category. Each row: action name left, shortcut key combo right in a mono kbd badge. kbd styling: 1px border, 4px radius, mono font, 0.75rem. Esc or clicking outside dismisses.
description-zh: 按 '?' 或 Cmd+/ 触发。模态浮层列示所有快捷键，按类别分组。每行：操作名左、组合键右（mono kbd 徽章）。kbd 样式：1px 边框、4px 圆角、等宽字体、0.75rem。Esc 或点击浮层外关闭。

description-en: A dashed-border drop zone (2px dash, accent color) with centered icon + 'Drop files here or click to browse'. Active state: solid border, sky-50 background, subtle pulse. Show file preview thumbnails below after drop. Always provide a fallback file input for accessibility.
description-zh: 虚线边框放置区（2px 虚线，主色），居中图标 + '拖放文件或点击浏览'。激活态：实线边框、sky-50 背景、微脉冲。放置后下方显示文件缩略图。始终提供后备文件输入保证无障碍。
